artifacts.bundle_name: Alex Jones interview clip with Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: Alex Jones segment in which Phil Lyman recounts being at the east end outside, hearing a loud boom, encountering two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee and one of whom said "Go f yourselves," and his stated view that the .30-06 rifle was never fired from the roof.

artifacts.bundle_name: NewsNation interview clip with Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: NewsNation segment in which Phil Lyman describes walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him and then running back out to investigate.

artifacts.bundle_name: Post-shooting video footage sent to host by Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: Mobile phone video with embedded metadata timestamp 12:23 showing Phil Lyman inside the Sorenson Center building walking out calmly and engaging two people in black clothing in conversation; no one in the clip is depicted fleeing.

BearingPoint Graz office introduction video identifying members of one of the company's software development teams; the host identifies one of the individuals shown as Gernot Omer and displays a side-by-side with the figure in the Broderick companion photo.

Blog post titled "Anniversary Hike, 10 Years on Foot to the Sea," describing a group of 30-year-olds recreating a hike taken at age 20; contains photos matching the face of the individual identified as Gernot Omer.

artifacts.bundle_name: Buzzard and Bees website (Provo gothic underground)

sub_items.description: Public-facing page from the "Buzzard and Bees" gothic-underground Provo website referencing a "gothic prom," featuring a person in makeup the host matches via side-by-side image to the unidentified individual in the Broderick companion photo.

artifacts.bundle_name: Daily Mail article on FBI Utah leadership purge

sub_items.description: Article headlined "Kash Patel questions grow as it's revealed he gutted the Utah FBI leadership before Charlie Kirk's assassination," recounting that Patel fired the Utah Bureau chief and other personnel and installed Robert Bowles in August 2025.

artifacts.bundle_name: November 1999 article on Detective Mike Mitchell

sub_items.description: Article titled "Police surf internet to snag pedophiles," describing Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Detective Mike Mitchell using an online persona with childlike language to lure suspected pedophiles; states Mitchell had been investigating internet child-sex crimes for about a year (i.e., since approximately 1998) and was assigned to the Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office.

Letter attributed to Charlie Kirk expressing "deep love for Israel," reported to have been written in May and released by the Prime Minister's office roughly two weeks after the September 10 assassination; circulated via the New York Post and Israeli Post. Referenced on air; underlying letter/email not displayed.
Instagram post by Shainer Broderick identifying Phil Lyman as "my uncle Phil Lyman" (described on air; post itself not displayed in this episode).
Shainer Broderick LinkedIn profile connection listing Phil Lyman as uncle, referenced as a factor in his securing an internship with Senator Mike Lee of Utah.
LinkedIn profile stating Gernot Omer relocated to Utah in May 2024 to take a software engineer position with JP Morgan Chase.
Email from a viewer in Belfast, Northern Ireland, reporting a facial-recognition search of the unidentified companion produced a single hit in Provo, Utah, on the "Buzzard and Bees" gothic-prom page.

Email from a long-time bulletproof-vest supplier stating that his contract with Charlie Kirk's campus tour was not renewed prior to the final spring tour, with the supplier told Charlie wanted to "go a different direction" using an army-style metal vest instead. Paraphrased on air; underlying email not displayed.

nodes.name: Shainer Broderick
nodes.description: Phil Lyman's nephew (per Broderick's own Instagram and LinkedIn) or cousin (per Phil's revised claim to the host); retraced the killer's footpath with two companions shortly after the shooting and produced a map used by media. Wiped his LinkedIn and Facebook and cleared/privatized his Instagram following the host's previous episode.

nodes.name: Gernot Omer
nodes.description: Austrian national; identified by the host as one of two companions in the Broderick companion photo. Matched to a BearingPoint Graz software team YouTube video and a German-language "Anniversary Hike" blog; LinkedIn indicates relocation to Utah in May 2024 for a software engineering role at JP Morgan Chase.

nodes.name: BB Netanyahu
nodes.description: Israeli Prime Minister; referenced as having released the May Charlie Kirk letter roughly two weeks after the September 10 assassination. (Note: transcript renders the familiar "Bibi" as "BB"; preserved as transcribed; flagged.)

nodes.name: Robert Bowles
nodes.description: Reported as the individual installed to lead the Utah FBI field office in August 2025 following Kash Patel's purge of prior leadership; described as based in DC for decades and in his first week on the job at the time of the shooting.

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell
nodes.description: Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office detective; per a 1999 article, conducts online undercover work creating personas to identify suspected pedophiles. Flag: this entity is likely to already possess a node ID from prior episodes covering his role in the Charlie Kirk case; verify ledger and merge if confirmed.

nodes.name: Kash Patel
nodes.description: FBI Director; per a Daily Mail article cited in the episode, fired the chief of the Utah FBI Bureau and other personnel and replaced them with Robert Bowles in August 2025, weeks before the assassination. Flag: may already have a node ID from prior episodes; verify ledger and merge if confirmed.

nodes.name: Phil Lyman Location Discrepancy
nodes.description: Persistent inconsistency across three artifact-anchored sources regarding Phil Lyman's position at the moment of the shot: (1) Alex Jones interview places him at the east end outdoors, (2) NewsNation interview places him entering a building and then running out, and (3) video with 12:23 metadata timestamp shows him already inside the Sorenson Center building walking out calmly.

nodes.name: Unidentified Goth Person in Broderick Companion Photo
nodes.description: The second of two foreign companions in the photo with Shainer Broderick; matched by a Belfast viewer to a person on the Provo gothic-underground site "Buzzard and Bees." Remains unidentified by name as of this episode.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Pre-Mortem Israel Position Claim
nodes.description: Host assertion that approximately 48 hours before his death Charlie Kirk informed Turning Point USA staff, Jewish donors, and a rabbi that he was abandoning the pro-Israel cause, and that he intended to bring Candace Owens back. Currently host-testimony only with no displayed artifact in this episode; TPUSA has been publicly challenged to deny. Verification target.

nodes.name: Hospital Routing Discrepancy
nodes.description: Host assertion that Timpanogos Regional Hospital was not the closest trauma-equipped facility and that the hospital had just named Andrew Zenger as a new CEO/surgeon on the same day Charlie's tour was announced. Lacks displayed artifact in this episode; verification target.

nodes.name: Utah FBI Personnel Replacement
nodes.description: Verified via Daily Mail: Kash Patel fired the Utah FBI Bureau chief and additional personnel, replaced by Robert Bowles in August 2025; Bowles in his first week on the job at the time of the shooting. Investigation target remains: who approved the timing, who vetted Bowles, and what the chain of command was on September 10.

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell Undercover Role Verification
nodes.description: Verification target: confirm whether the Detective Mike Mitchell named in the 1999 article is the same Mike Mitchell involved in the Charlie Kirk case, his tenure length (article states approximately one year as of 1999), and whether his specialty in online decoy personas is causally connected to the George Zinn decoy-boy episode.

nodes.name: Phil Lyman
nodes.description: Utah Lt. Gov. candidate; per host, the GMA connection was routed through his campaign to Tiffany Barker.

claims.label: Phil Lyman told Alex Jones he was outside at the east end, heard a loud boom, encountered two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee, and quoted one as saying "Go f yourselves."
claims.claim: Phil Lyman's on-air account to Alex Jones places him outdoors and characterizes two individuals at the scene as goth and unresponsive.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Phil's Alex Jones account verbatim against (a) the NewsNation account (C-1322) and (b) the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to characterize the discrepancy as edit, memory, or misrepresentation.

claims.label: Phil Lyman told NewsNation he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate.
claims.claim: Phil Lyman's on-air account to NewsNation places him approaching/inside a building at the moment of the shot, then exiting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference timestamp of "ran out" with the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to determine whether Phil was inside or approaching at the moment of the shot.

claims.label: Video metadata timestamp shows Phil Lyman inside the Sorenson building at 12:23 on the day of the shooting, walking out calmly.
claims.claim: A mobile-phone video provided by Phil Lyman to the host contains embedded metadata placing him inside the Sorenson Center building at 12:23 on September 10, 2025; the video depicts him walking out calmly rather than running.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original file with full EXIF metadata; forensically confirm capture time, device, and chain of custody.

claims.label: The two individuals in Phil Lyman's aftermath footage are wearing black clothing but do not display abnormal behavior; the host states one may be a man.
claims.claim: Visual review of Phil Lyman's aftermath video shows two individuals in black (one possibly male) behaving normally; the host disputes Phil's Alex Jones characterization of them as "goth" and unfazed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare visible individuals in A-1185.1 with the two companions in the Broderick photo (A-1192.1); determine whether they are the same individuals.

claims.label: One of the two companions in the photo with Shainer Broderick has been identified as Gernot Omer via face-match to a BearingPoint Graz office YouTube video.
claims.claim: A face in the companion photo matches an individual shown in a BearingPoint company video introducing software development teams at the Graz office.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Broderick companion photo from prior episode; perform controlled side-by-side facial comparison and reach out to BearingPoint HR to confirm Gernot Omer's employment dates.

claims.label: Gernot Omer's LinkedIn states he moved to Utah in May 2024 to take a software engineer position with JP Morgan Chase.
claims.claim: The publicly visible LinkedIn profile for Gernot Omer indicates relocation to Utah in May 2024 for employment at JP Morgan Chase.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture and archive the LinkedIn profile as displayed; verify with JP Morgan Chase HR whether the employment record matches.

claims.label: A Belfast viewer matched the second companion's face via a facial-recognition search to a single result in Provo, Utah — on the "Buzzard and Bees" gothic-prom page.
claims.claim: A viewer in Belfast, Northern Ireland, reported to the host via email that an internet-wide facial search of the unidentified companion returned a single hit on a person in Provo, Utah, depicted on the "Buzzard and Bees" gothic-prom page.
claims.investigative_direction: Replicate the facial search; identify the named subject on the Buzzard and Bees page; determine whether the person is Austrian or otherwise foreign.

claims.label: Shainer Broderick previously identified Phil Lyman as his uncle on both Instagram and LinkedIn.
claims.claim: Public social media posts and a LinkedIn profile connection listed Phil Lyman as Shainer Broderick's uncle prior to the host's coverage.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Instagram and LinkedIn snapshots from prior to deletion/scrub; reconcile with Phil Lyman's later "cousin, not nephew" revision.

claims.label: The Daily Mail reports Kash Patel fired the Utah FBI Bureau chief and additional personnel before Charlie Kirk's assassination and replaced the chief with Robert Bowles.
claims.claim: A Daily Mail article reports FBI Director Kash Patel removed the chief of the Utah FBI Bureau and additional personnel and installed Robert Bowles in August 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying DOJ/FBI HR records for the Utah field office; verify the date of Robert Bowles's transfer and the names of all removed personnel.

claims.label: A November 1999 article describes Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Detective Mike Mitchell as an undercover detective using online personas to lure suspected pedophiles, beginning approximately one year prior (i.e., circa 1998).
claims.claim: A 1999 article documents that Detective Mike Mitchell had been investigating internet child-sex crimes for about a year by November 1999, employing an online persona with childlike language.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm continuity between the 1999 Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Mitchell and the Mike Mitchell referenced in the Charlie Kirk investigation; obtain his full service record.

claims.label: Roughly two weeks after the September 10, 2025 assassination, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's office released a May 2025 letter attributed to Charlie Kirk expressing "deep love for Israel" and offering strategic counsel.
claims.claim: A letter written by Charlie Kirk in May 2025 to the Israeli Prime Minister expressing deep love for Israel and strategic suggestions was released by the Prime Minister's office approximately two weeks after the assassination and circulated by the New York Post and Israeli Post.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original letter or email (timestamp, metadata); reconcile with contemporaneous statements by TPUSA staff and the host's 48-hour claim.

claims.label: The supplier who had provided Charlie Kirk's campus-tour bulletproof vests reports his contract was not renewed for the final spring tour, with Charlie allegedly wanting an army-style metal vest instead.
claims.claim: An email from a long-time bulletproof-vest supplier describes contract non-renewal and a stated rationale that Charlie wanted an "army vest" direction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying email and supplier invoices; verify whether any alternative armor was actually worn on September 10 and which vendor supplied it.

claims.label: Gernot Omer's face was matched to a German-language blog post titled "Anniversary Hike, 10 Years on Foot to the Sea" featuring a group of 30-year-olds recreating a hike taken at age 20.
claims.claim: A German-language blog post on a 10-year hiking anniversary contains photos matching the face of the individual identified as Gernot Omer.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm authorship and dating of the blog; verify Gernot Omer's participation in the original 20-year-old hike and the 10-year reunion.

claims.label: Robert Bowles was in his first week leading the Utah FBI field office at the time of the Charlie Kirk shooting.
claims.claim: The Daily Mail account places Robert Bowles in his first week on the Utah FBI assignment at the time of the September 10 assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bowles's official start date via FBI HR records and tie to the timeline of investigative actions on September 10.
